title: Michael.jar
description: This is the scariest mod ever! - Markus Persson, 5 star rating.
body:
This is the scariest mod ever! - Markus Persson, 5 star rating.

**He** always sees you. **He** knows where you are. **He** knows where you live. **He** knows where you sleep. **He** knows everything about you. This is **HIS** world. Sometimes you hear strange sounds, like: "Hee-Hee." which is very scary!

This mod adds Michael to minecraft, as a way to scare you, since you probably like horror mods. Michael wont break any blocks, Michael wont kill you in one hit, Michael will just have _fun_ with you.

Current features of the mod:
- Michael spawns, chases you and scares you!
- that's... it... for now. (maybe)

If you found any bugs or problems, make sure to report them.

**REQUIRES GECKOLIB!**

_Not tested in multiplayer._

Developer note:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This is clearly not a real horror mod, this mod was made for fun and has no intention of harming someone's feelings, I respect Michael and his legacy. Depending on the mod's popularity, or if I feel like it, I may or may not add more content to this stupid mod.

</details>
